title: Graduate statistical mechanics
purpose: Analyze interacting systems, fluctuations and phase transitions using statistical mechanics and controlled approximations.
primary_reading: Perimeter PSI Online course collection — Select the Theoretical Mechanics, Statistical Physics or Cosmology module matching this course. Use the module notes and exercises by topic.

blocks.deliverable: Derive fluctuations and state the relevant limit.
Calculate a susceptibility or fluctuation relation.
Derive a self consistency equation and test its limits.
Week 7 midterm; compare critical exponents within an approximation.
Explain a coarse graining step with a concrete model.
Monitor equilibration and autocorrelation in a simulation.
Submit reproducible results and a graduate stat mechanics examination.

project: Simulate a finite Ising model and explain finite size effects and the limits of a mean field comparison.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
